summary:
IT Detectives – NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026

Our team, IT Detectives, is developing EarthTrend Detective — an educational and scientific interactive project designed to make NASA satellite data accessible, understandable, and engaging for everyone.

The project allows users to explore our planet through an interactive 3D model of Earth featuring 39 data layers covering various natural and environmental indicators, including air temperature, vegetation health, ocean chlorophyll concentration, and much more.

Users can compare any two countries, analyze changes in specific locations over the past 40 years, track monthly changes in the front line, and explore events observed by satellites from space. Every identified trend can be verified using real statistical data, while personal observations, research findings, and interesting discoveries can be saved as notes.

Our mission is to combine science, modern technology, and education to help people better understand changes on Earth, explore global processes, and draw their own conclusions based on reliable scientific data.

EarthTrend Detective — Explore Earth, Discover Changes, Uncover Patterns!
details:
Our team, IT Detectives, is developing EarthTrend Detective, an interactive educational and scientific platform that helps people explore and understand our planet using NASA satellite data. The project features an interactive 3D globe with 39 data layers, including air temperature, vegetation health, ocean chlorophyll, and other environmental indicators. Users can compare any two countries, analyze changes over the past 40 years, track monthly changes along the front line, and explore events observed from space. They can also verify trends using real statistical data and save their observations and research findings as personal notes.

Our project makes complex scientific information accessible and easy to understand. It encourages independent learning, develops critical thinking, and helps students, teachers, and researchers better understand environmental changes and global processes. Our goal is to make science more accessible, inspire curiosity, and encourage people to explore our planet through reliable satellite observations.

We combine NASA satellite data with modern web technologies such as JavaScript, React, Three.js, MapLibre, and Apache ECharts to create an engaging and interactive experience. The creative aspect of our project is the combination of 39 data layers in one 3D globe, allowing users to become explorers and researchers rather than simply observe information. They can discover patterns, compare locations, investigate changes, test trends, and record their own discoveries.

During development, our team focused on scientific accuracy, data reliability, accessibility, usability, and educational value. We also considered different user needs, historical data availability, and language accessibility. That is why the platform supports both English and Ukrainian and is designed to be useful even for people without a scientific background.

EarthTrend Detective aims to connect science, technology, and education, helping everyone explore Earth, discover changes, and uncover patterns.
